en: It has been made permissible for you
the night preceding fasting to go to your wives [for sexual relations].
They are a clothing for you
and you are a clothing for them.
Allah knows
that you used to deceive yourselves,
so He accepted your repentance
and forgave you.
So now, have relations with them
and seek that which Allah has decreed for you [i.e., offspring].
And eat and drink
until the white thread of dawn becomes distinct to you
from the black thread
from the black thread [of night].
Then complete the fast until the night [i.e., sunset].
And do not have relations with them
as long as you are staying for worship in the mosques.
These are the limits [set by] Allah,
These are the limits [set by] Allah,
so do not approach them.
Thus does Allah make clear His verses [i.e., ordinances] to the people
that they may become righteous.
